answer.title: The Ember Road
answer.narration:
Smoke stings your nose as you stride into Karrowmere's market square, shoulders broad enough to turn heads. Then you see why: the fountain has gone dry, and a dozen villagers stand around it, panicking.

An old woman in a faded blue shawl grabs your sleeve. "Mage! The spring in the hills has stopped. Something fiery sits on it. Please, we'll be dead of thirst in days."

Behind her, the hills glow a sullen red.
choices: Ask what the villagers have seen
